description: A reply whose '{{' reads what the node's scope does not hold: draft_plan's reply is rendered as
a template before it composes, so {{ months }} fails the node and the job fails ('reply failed
to render'). Deliverables already released stay composed; plan and those still waiting on a
release when the job failed (single, pair, tally) are unsettled.

inputs.consult_draft: Margaret Okafor, 64, seen for breathlessness on exertion. Echo shows mild aortic stenosis. Review in six months. (Fictional.)

outputs.draft_plan: Repeat the echo in {{ months }} months.
